assessments.reasoning: The SPDX-generated AGPL-3.0-or-later.xml at the claim's data commit contains the matching ID, name and notes. The complete opening license tag lacks deprecatedVersion. Its standardLicenseHeader is nested inside text/optional in the application exhibit. Reading that marked element supplies the later-version example directly from this record.

The pinned SPDX field guide identifies the mandatory ID and title attributes and explains when deprecatedVersion should appear. It defines isOsiApproved separately. The or-later record contains isOsiApproved but omits deprecatedVersion, while the historical record carries both, confirming that the approval attribute cannot stand in for the deprecation marker.

challenge.method: I checked whether the version-3 title or the optional markup in the embedded standardLicenseHeader supported a version-3-only reading of the example.
challenge.results: The title identifies the license edition. Within the header's grant sentence, the inner optional element encloses only the parenthetical about the recipient's option. Omitting that parenthetical leaves the offer of any later version intact. The notes independently identify the same choice.

limitations: The deprecation finding concerns this release's XML entry. Its template illustrates a notice choice. An actual work's grant, the FSF publisher's plaintext bytes and redistribution rights for the composite XML are separate questions.

The revision-1 claim's connector-reported digest matched the frozen digest. Digest checks relied on connector metadata. The named fields were inspected directly because the connector supplied no range offsets.
reasoning: The pinned license element pairs AGPL-3.0-or-later with the exact name GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 or later and omits deprecatedVersion. Its notes describe the choice between version 3 and a later version. Its own standardLicenseHeader illustrates a notice offering version 3 or any later version.
